title: #12375 Make OpenEDocument method public
summary: The OpenEDocument method in the E-Document table is now public to allow other document types to reuse document opening logic without code duplication.
key_points: The OpenEDocument method on the E-Document table is now public
Lets other document type entities open E-Document pages from their own code
Avoids duplicating the logic that opens E-Documents
Small change limited to the E-Document table
quote: We want to open E-Document pages from other document type entities without duplicating the code.
